title: What If a Rocket Could Land and Fly 37 Times? One Did

scenes.text: What if a rocket could land itself and fly again? One booster has done it 37 times.
Booster B1067 completed its 37th flight in August 2026, carrying 29 Starlink satellites.
Each time, the first stage lands on four legs on a droneship in the Atlantic Ocean.
Its earlier missions include the astronaut flights Crew-3 and Crew-4, plus the CRS-22 cargo mission.
It passed 35 flights in June 2026, a record for any Falcon 9 booster.
The overall reuse record belongs to a space shuttle orbiter, at 39 flights. This booster is two short.

description:
What if a rocket could land and fly again and again?
One Falcon 9 booster has now flown 37 times, just two short of the space shuttle record of 39.
What should we run through next?
